name: ubersdr-desktop
description: UberSDR desktop client — the v2 web UI in an Electron shell with an instance chooser
author: MadPsy
//desktopName: Read by Electron itself (app.setDesktopName) and by electron-builder, which writes it as StartupWMClass. They must agree or the desktop environment cannot match a running window to the .desktop entry, and the taskbar shows a generic icon. Electron's fallback is `${app.name}.desktop` = ubersdr-desktop.desktop, so that is the name to pin.
